name: rollcall_vmingxiaotentacle
about: Roll call: classname npc_VMingXiaoTentacle builds CNPC_VMingXiaoTentacle (factory 0x1039af30, research/tooling/ghidra/driver/kernel_factories.tsv). No map places it directly; ch_temple_4's TentacleGenerator (npc_maker, NPCType npc_VMingXiaoTentacle, NPCTargetname Tentacle, Flag_StartDisabled 1) stands verbatim and its Spawn input makes one child through CNPCMaker (0x1034aae0); the child then runs NPCThink 0x10292de0 -> RunAI 0x1026f110 -> MaintainSchedule: SelectSchedule picks a program and SetSchedule 0x10280e50 installs it, and the program runs for the rest of the ten seconds without a task failing every think.
